entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Sita's father, a former consul who recruits Rudra to bring a bloody end to the race and retake Kaladesh.

entities.name: Rudra
entities.description: A scarred former guard captain once court-martialed, now hired by Gonti for race security and asked by Mohar to help him.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: The night minister who hired Rudra for race security.

entities.name: Vin
entities.description: A stylish eyeball race commentator who interviews Grennar.

entities.name: Grennar
entities.description: A large ape Fang Druid and race sponsor on Muraganda who fears more visitors and hurls the camera.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker pyromancer who abandons the race to rescue Loot from raiders and finds a shortcut through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: The masked racer who slips through the raiders and recalls losing family friends to the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Mincemeat
entities.description: An Endriders racer who idolizes Far Fortune and falls into a raider pit.

entities.name: Far Fortune
entities.description: The brave Endriders leader.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin Rocketeers boss captured by raiders and caged with Loot.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.description: A goblin Rocketeer who abandons Daretti, promising to be a cooler boss.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A small fuzzy, glowing-tailed creature who was caged by Winter and can open Omenpaths, formerly known to Vraska.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: The Speed Demons leader who keeps Loot caged and swerves so that raiders tear the cage free.

entities.name: Kolodin
entities.description: Cloudspire's captain who tells Chandra not to throw away victory.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother who orders Spitfire to the valley, then rescues Chandra and the captive captains.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: The leader of the Amonkheti Champions.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: The sand-bending Amonkheti champion who cuts through falling trees.

entities.name: Khuru
aliases: the man who died saving Zahur
entities.description: A raised Amonkheti Champion who rides with Basri and Zahur.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Chandra's partner who would not forgive her getting hurt.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who says 'Fear is the last thing to leave' before battles.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Someone Chandra met who made her lose one of her newest friends.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who gave Loot chocolate-like drink.

entities.name: Ishani
entities.description: Sita's mother's best friend, whose house the Invasion Tree crashes into.

entities.name: Raiders
entities.description: Heavily armed lizardmen on dinosaurs who attack the racers on Muraganda and take captives for sacrifice.

entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: Winter's spectral team.

entities.name: Rocketeers
entities.description: Goblin racers led by Daretti.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: Rugged racers led by Fortune.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: Amonkheti racing team.

entities.name: Team Cloudspire
entities.description: Chandra's racing team.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Spitfire's team.

entities.name: Alacrian Quickbeasts
entities.description: A flying beast team.

entities.name: Guidelight Voyagers
entities.description: Automaton racers.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane of giant falling trees, moonfalls and floating rivers where the third leg takes place.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane Mohar wants to retake.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's mention of a plane with little taller than shrubs.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: The race prize.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: The planar route Loot reveals inside a tree.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The multiplanar race.

events.summary: Mohar says a powerful mind mage has agreed to help him.
events.quote: A powerful mind mage has agreed to lend us his assistance with

events.summary: Mohar asks his old friend Rudra, now in the barracks, to help restore Kaladesh by force.
events.quote: I need a force to put an end to the race.

events.summary: Mohar says no revolution worth having has been bloodless, accepting a bloody trap at the finish line.
events.quote: No revolution worth having has ever been bloodless.

events.summary: Grennar mocks Vin's claim that the islands float.
events.quote: They're falling,

events.summary: Grennar hurls Vin's camera at the river above.
events.quote: hurls the camera as hard as he can toward the river up above.

events.summary: Chandra races through giant oaks that crash down onto the course.
events.quote: Towering oaks reach up to a sky glittering with stars, only to come crashing down right onto them.

events.summary: Chandra slips past two Voyagers who crash into a wheel hub.
events.quote: The wanderers smack straight into the wheel hubs without any time to adjust

events.summary: Chandra hurls a fireball that burns a tunnel through a falling tree.
events.quote: She hurls the fireball at the oncoming tree.

events.summary: Emerging in first, Chandra sees Winter ahead of her again.
events.quote: Winter is somehow right up ahead of her.

events.summary: Spitfire waits for the Amonkheti to cut through a tree rather than use Chandra's tunnel.
events.quote: she throws the ride into reverse and waits for the Amonkheti to slice through the tree.

events.summary: Spitfire sees the raised Khuru riding with Basri and Zahur.
events.quote: the man who died saving Zahur only yesterday

events.summary: A moonfall quake begins and the Amonkheti chariot hippo bolts for shelter.
events.quote: Sure enough, the gentle tremble beneath them intensifies into a hungry growl from the earth.

events.summary: Flashback: Spitfire recalls the Phyrexian arm piercing Ghirapur and fighting her fused guards.
events.quote: Two years ago, she'd woken up one morning to see a massive, porcelain-plated arm piercing the city she knew and loved.

events.summary: Pia orders Spitfire to pull into the valley and Spitfire obeys.
events.quote: She turns toward the valley.

events.summary: A pit opens under Mincemeat and the Endriders; she lands in Fortune's trunk.
events.quote: A yawning pit opens beneath her, one large enough to swallow Mincemeat and the five riders around her.

events.summary: A giant dinosaur carrying a fortress and a dozen mounted lizardman raiders attack the trapped racers.
events.quote: There's a ramshackle fortress on its back comprised of three levels of wood and lizardmen.

events.summary: Daretti's goblins charge the beast but run into a snare net and raiders capture them.
events.quote: He can see it now: the net holding them aloft and the glowing, reptilian eyes of their captors.

events.summary: Redshift and the goblins bail out of the trapped vehicle, abandoning Daretti.
events.quote: Bye, Boss! Real nice working with you!

events.summary: Chandra senses a hidden dinosaur and slides away from its leap.
events.quote: Chandra spots the spiny crown of a dinosaur hiding in a pit the instant before he leaps toward them.

events.summary: A raider's hook tears Loot's cage from Winter's vehicle and drops Loot into a sack.
events.quote: Momentum and angles combine to tear the hook free—and the cage along with it.

events.summary: Chandra abandons the race and jumps onto a dinosaur to rescue Loot.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar jumps from her ride and hitches a ride on one that's more old-fashioned.

events.summary: Spitfire injects aether and slips through the raiders and dinosaur to take the lead.
events.quote: She jams another canister of aether into the port on the suit's shoulder and twists.

events.summary: Chandra's ride is crushed by a dinosaur and Spitfire sees her clinging to a raptor.
events.quote: The younger Nalaar's ride is crushed underfoot by a rampaging dinosaur.

events.summary: Flashback: Sita and her father are caught in traffic as the Invasion Tree crashes into Ishani's house.
events.quote: Twenty minutes later, they were only half a mile down the road, and Sita watched a limb of the Invasion Tree crash into Ishani's house.

events.summary: Spitfire switches off her radio and leaves Chandra behind.
events.quote: With a flick of a switch, Spitfire switches off her radio.

events.summary: Daretti is caged with Loot and introduces himself.
events.quote: The name's Daretti.

events.summary: Daretti shares Fioran chocolate with Loot as they expect to be sacrificed.
events.quote: If we're going to be sacrificed the way they say, at least we'll go out like gentlemen

events.summary: Loot spots a sneaking Chandra in Cloudspire colors.
events.quote: Slinking among the foliage, he sees a slip of orange-red fire

events.summary: Pia crumbles a raider as he finds Chandra hiding in Daretti's vehicle.
events.quote: the raider ends up crumbling to the ground like a stack of pebbles.

events.summary: Pia picks the cage lock and frees Loot and Daretti.
events.quote: And, sure enough, Chandra's mom has the lock figured out all before Daretti has even realized there's anything going on behind him.

events.summary: Chandra offers Loot a place with Team Cloudspire.
events.quote: If you like, you can hang out with me and Team Cloudspire.

events.summary: Chandra sets off a fireball that blows up half the raiders' camp as they escape.
events.quote: As half of the camp explodes, she hops into the ride with the others.

events.summary: Following Loot's cue, Chandra steers left into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath.
events.quote: Beneath it, the spiraling light of an Omenpath.

events.summary: They crash across the border into a different world.
events.quote: A second later, they crash over the border into a different world.

relations.note: Old friend he asks for help.
relations.quote: He takes a seat across from his old friend.

relations.note: Gonti has hired him for security.
relations.quote: And he's already hired you for security.
Where would you be without your mother looking out for you, hm?
Nissa's never going to forgive Chandra if she gets hurt doing this.
Well, at least I'll have good company.
I promise I'll be a better boss than you ever were!

relations.note: Vraska once gave him a chocolate drink.
relations.quote: Oh, that smells like the stuff Vraska gave him sometimes!

relations.note: Winter kept him in a cage.
relations.quote: the too-small cage, and Winter's awful goons
